integrity: The proof reconstructs the heavy-ball recurrence, derives the exact second solution polynomial, and proves the diagonal all-iterate statement through a closed Chebyshev-U representation and an analytic uniform bound. The packaged exact-rational checker independently replays the finite algebra and witness.
scientific_limitations: The exact second-iterate classification is for symmetric positive definite Stieltjes systems. The stronger all-iterate statement is restricted to diagonal systems. Later iterates for general non-diagonal Stieltjes matrices and robustness to misspecified spectral endpoints are not classified.
title: Condition nine is the sharp positivity frontier for optimally tuned heavy-ball
